verifications.note: EIA's natural gas pipeline projects table, August 2026 release. The Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 1170, lists Western Marcellus Pipeline Project/Appalachian Connector with Transcontinental Gas Pipeline as the operator. It is an expansion through Ohio, West Virginia and Virginia, 2,000 million cubic feet per day, on hold.

EIA's Natural Gas Weekly Update from September 11, 2014. It says Williams Partners opened an open season for the Western Marcellus Pipeline project and calls it an expansion on Williams's Transcontinental Pipeline (Transco), running nearly 400 miles from northern West Virginia to a Transco compressor station in southern Virginia.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The owner cell named Williams Companies Inc, which is the parent company. Owner should be the company that would hold the pipe. EIA lists the project under Transcontinental Gas Pipeline in its newest projects table, and a 2014 EIA weekly update calls it an expansion of Transco. The Operator cell already names Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Co LLC. EIA uses both names, Western Marcellus and Appalachian Connector, for this one project.

values.Owner1: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Co LLC

verifications.note: Southern Company's annual report on Form 10-K for 2023. It says the Dalton Pipeline is a 115-mile pipeline jointly owned with The Williams Companies, an extension of the Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company system into northwest Georgia. Southern Company Gas holds a 50 percent undivided ownership interest and leases it for about 26 million dollars a year through 2042. The lessee maintains the pipeline and provides service under its tariff regulated by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The two owners on the sheet are right. Southern Company's 2023 annual report says Southern Company Gas owns half of the Dalton Pipeline, with Williams holding the other half, and leases its half to the operator through 2042. This stages the 50 percent shares and the reference, which were blank. The Williams half is written as Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Co LLC, the Williams company that runs the lateral, as on the other Transco rows. The report does not name the Williams company that holds the title.
